The '''SPD-R4 spider droid''' was a model of [[Service droid/Legends|service droid]]/[[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] commonly used in [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] installations such as the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]] and [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]]; aboard automated ships such as the ''[[Another Chance]]''; and by civilians.

==Features==
The model was [[Spider/Legends|spider]]-like, with a spherical metal body and eight multi-jointed legs covered with cleanser application nozzles, grippers, and cutting blades. Its bendable appendages allowed it to easily navigate [[Power core/Legends|power cores]] and [[Engine/Legends|engine]] blocks aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]], carrying out repair and maintenance in places inaccessible to [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. The droid also possessed welding/defensive [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. In addition to maintenance and repair, the droids could serve as pest exterminators, targeting [[Exogorth/Legends|exogorths]], [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]], and [[Vervikk/Legends|vervikks]].
